title: Saucer Beans
description: Saucer Beans is a small SMP modpack experiment with flying ships, cooking and an infection players can choose to unleash when they get bored
body:
Imagine this - your friends start a modded server. It all starts nicely, people spread around, build houses, send each other letters and cook meals. You beat the ender dragon and then things die down. What can we do to stop it?

Flying airships. With cannons. Players love cannons.

Okay, maybe it's not **the** solution, but cannons will keep players invested. So will flying contraptions. End remastered will keep them from reaching the end. Oh, and then there's a bio weapon to keep things interesting... 

In Saucer beans, Spore infection is disabled by deafult. You can however, find a way to bring the spicy mushrooms back, weaponize them and cause a server wide apocalypse. Or just chill out, cook some meals and send a postcard. The choice is yours. After all, every world is a story... but it seems like this one has been going on for a while. Rare cities full of pillagers suggest that this world has been previously abandoned. Surely that won't cause any issues, right?
